title: Reebok vs Cabbage Patch (Which is Which??) | Hip Hop Dance Steps

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down foundational hip hop steps methodically, addressing common confusions and naming multiple variations. He explains each variation step-by-step with arm and foot patterns.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to breaking down two hip hop steps and settling a community debate
Demonstration of the dance steps to music
Discussion on learning from credible sources and acknowledging Buddha Stretch
Introducing Cabbage Patch and Reebok steps and confusion between them
Breaking down Cabbage Patch basic variation with arms and upper body opposition
Adding footwork to the basic Cabbage Patch variation
Practicing arm and foot patterns at different tempos
Explaining the Around The World variation
Explaining the Stir The Pot variation
Explaining the Side to Side variation

cues: Draw a circle with our arms
metaphors: drawing a circle with our arms
common_mistakes: Confusing the Cabbage Patch with the Reebok

steps_taught.name: Cabbage Patch (Basic)
steps_taught.description: Drawing arm circles while moving the upper body in opposition with optional foot lifts.

steps_taught.name: Around The World
steps_taught.description: Cabbage patch basic variation adding body rotation.

steps_taught.name: Stir The Pot
steps_taught.description: Cabbage patch footwork with arms modified to a stirring motion.

steps_taught.name: Side to Side
steps_taught.description: Cabbage patch variation utilizing single-single-double arm movements side to side.

what_works: Clear verbal separation of arm and foot patterns
Breaking down variations one by one with descriptive names
what_hinders: Rapid transitions between multiple variations without full song practice

quotes.text: Today we're going to be breaking down two separate hip hop steps.
The two steps that we're going to be breaking down today that often can get mistaken for each other are the Cabbage Patch and the Reebok.
We're simply going to think about finding and drawing a circle with our arms.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor speaks directly to camera in a wooden room setting with hand gestures.
Instructor performs dance moves facing forward with upper body rotation and arm circles.
Instructor demonstrates arm movements counting out loud and showing body opposition.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact muscular engagement in the core

extraction.distinctive_method: Structuring the lesson around resolving a specific community debate and naming multiple stylistic variations of a single step.
